figures.caption: Table 3: Evaluation results of single-turn retrieval systems augmented with various reranker models on QuestionAnswering benchmarks. Qwen-2.5-3B-Instruct is used as the model for answer generation.

Figure 1: Comparison of Search-R1 vs. Verbal-R3 inference procedures. The original document contains a large amount of extraneous information, which makes Search-R1 hallucinate and produce an incorrect answer. In contrast, Verbal-R3 successfully exploits Verbal Annotations to distinguish relevant information, allowing the Generator to avoid hallucinations and generate a correct answer.
